# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred short call snippets. After filtering out pure internal-ops chatter (crane/driver loading coordination, cutting-machine/operator production talk with "Yuvraj Operator", app/attendance issues, and clearly personal/unrelated calls like the long rambling "Vishal" conversations about cricket, silver rates, family matters), a genuine core of **B2B steel-trading sales calls** remains — roughly 120-150 usable exchanges with repeat customers, dealers, fabricators, and site engineers across Tamil Nadu (and a few Vizag/Mumbai/Andhra counterparties).

The real sales signal is strongest in: (1) rate-enquiry and rate-negotiation calls, (2) stock-availability checks, (3) MTC/Test-Certificate (TC) follow-ups that gate dispatch, and (4) payment-and-dispatch coordination. Honesty note: this is a thin, repetitive sample — many "sales" calls are actually quick status pings ("rate வந்துச்சா," "material ready-ஆ") rather than full persuasive sales conversations, so the Playbook below is built from the patterns that do recur rather than from a large diverse set of closing techniques.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC sells **long and flat steel products**, not roofing sheets. Confirmed product lines from the calls:

- **TMT rebar** — grades FE500/E250 and **550D/500D**. Multiple calls confirm 500D is now rare: *"500 கிடைக்காது sir... R&L production இல்ல... அவங்க இல்லன்னா யாருமே பண்ண மாட்டாங்க... 550D தான் sir வரும்"* [500 is unavailable; only 550D is being produced by RINL/Vizag]. TMT is sold in standard 12-meter lengths — bending/cutting to shorter lengths for bolt-work is generally refused: *"TMT-ல நம்ம 6 meter எப்பவுமே கொடுக்கலையே"* [we never give 6m in TMT].
- **MS Plates / HR Plates** — thickness range 2mm–20mm+, sizes like 2500×1250, 6300mm coil-cut, checkered plate. *"HR plate-லாம் இன்னைக்கு ₹66 + tax"*.
- **Structural sections** — ISMB, ISMC (channel), L-angle, SHS/RHS (square/rectangular hollow sections), I-sections, flats (e.g., "300-க்கு 140" flange sizes), MS round bars, pipes.
- **CR/CRS coil & sheet** — cold-rolled coil, cut sizes, also "CRS" (likely cold-rolled strip/sections) in 20mm and 32mm.
- Brands mentioned by name: **Vizag/RINL, SAIL, Tata Steel, JSW, "Vaisakh" (sale/trade brand), Apollo (pipes), NMDC (plates)**. Reps are candid about brand-rate parity: *"Vaisakh-க்கும் sale-க்கும் difference இருக்கா rate-ல? Rate different இருக்காது sir. ரெண்டுமே same price தான்."*
- Some items are explicitly **not stocked/dealt**: SHS tubes ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir"), CHS pipe ("நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am"), bolts/hanger bolts (fabricator-sourced, not BSC sale items).
- Material often comes via **local re-rolling/"conversion"** mills rather than big-brand mills when demand is high — reps are transparent: *"steel இப்ப கிடைக்குதே இல்ல conversion material இதெல்லாம் so இப்படித்தான் வரும்."*

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- TMT 12mm: **₹69/kg**, 16mm: **₹68.5/kg**, both **+ GST extra** (quoted to Vimalkumar/Saveetha Institute, Oct 2026 period).
- Steel sheet (2500mm, 8mm thickness): **₹65.5/kg** (quoted to V R Earth Movers).
- HR Plate 10–12mm: **₹66–68 + tax**; thicker sections add **₹1000–2000 extra**.
- ISMB/Channel/Angle: consistently quoted in the **₹65–67/kg** band; MS round **₹65–70/kg**.
- Checkered/normal plate (4–8mm): **₹63–66/kg** range depending on size and timing; one call shows negotiation from ₹64 down to **₹63.5**.
- 6mm MS plate (8×4 size): **₹66 + GST**, loading/transport extra.
- CRS 20mm (sale grade): **₹69,000** (per ton, implied), only one SKU available at the time.
- V R Earth Movers series (ISMB/sheet): rate moved **₹59–65/kg** over successive calls, with explicit increase notices: *"rate increase ஆகுது... ₹1500 increase ஆகும்னு சொல்றாங்க."*
- Vizag RNL base price examples (Oct–Nov 2026): **₹62,000–70,000** per ton depending on size (8mm–32mm), with smaller diameters (8–12mm) costing **₹2000–3500 more** than 16–25mm due to short supply.
- Standard quoting convention: **basic rate + GST + loading + transport, all extra** — repeated almost verbatim across calls: *"+ GST + loading transport எல்லாமே extra, நான் basic rate அதெல்லாம் as usual."*
- Transport/freight examples actually quoted: ₹1200/ton (min 14 ton loads), ₹1800 (Trichy–Thuvakudi 15–16 ton), ₹18/ton-equivalent lumpsum (Gudur/AP route), ₹3100/ton (Hyderabad–Coimbatore), ₹2100–2150 (Raichur/Hyderabad–Chennai), ₹2050 (Vizag–Chennai).
- Payment/handling charge dispute line item: **₹200 standard "payment charge"**, customer pushback when billed ₹250 — *"நீங்க எப்பவுமே... ₹200 தான் போடுற, திடீர்னு ₹250 போட்டுருக்காங்க"* — resolved via debit/credit note, not refund-in-cash.
- Credit terms: **1-month credit** mentioned once, after which enquiry "closed" — advance payment preferred: *"உங்களோடது advance, எனக்கு credit-ல close ஆயிடுச்சு."*
- Quotation validity: typically **1–2 days** given fast-moving steel prices — *"validity 2 days அப்படின்னு சொல்லிருக்காங்க."*

## Objection Playbook

1. **"Rate கம்மி பண்ண முடியுமா?" (Can you reduce the rate?)**
   Standard response: hold firm, cite transport/brand constraints, offer token ₹100–500 relief only. *"Same rate தான் sir போட்டுருக்கேன். Transport மட்டும் add பண்ணிருக்கேன்... ₹100-200 கம்மி பண்ணுங்
